title: Settings
_comment_shortcuts_detected: audit:ignore-fact — 'Detected:' is the user-visible label; {{platform}} interpolates the real value

fields.theme_sub: Light, dark, or follow the OS.
fields.accent_sub: Pick the highlight colour used across the app.
fields.font_sub: Typeface used across the interface. OpenDyslexic is a dyslexia-friendly font.
fields.font_size_sub: Scale the entire interface up or down for comfort.
fields.polling_interval_hint: How often Recrest asks your git hosts for new merge requests. Lower values update faster but use more bandwidth and can hit provider rate limits.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.high_contrast_sub: Reinforce borders and dim text for better legibility.
accessibility.underline_links_sub: Always underline links instead of only on hover.

ide.detection_hint: Install VS Code, Cursor, or a JetBrains IDE so its CLI is on your PATH.

sources.description: Folders Recrest scans recursively for git repositories.
sources.empty_desc: Add at least one folder so Recrest can discover your repositories.
sources.confirm_remove_desc: Repositories under {{path}} will disappear from the dashboard. The folder itself stays on disk.

providers.description: Connect a Personal Access Token to list merge requests.
providers.token_hint: A Personal Access Token is a long string issued by your git host instead of your password. Recrest needs one with read access to merge requests — e.g. the `repo` scope on GitHub, `read_api` on GitLab, or an app password with Pull Requests: Read on Bitbucket. Stored encrypted in your OS keychain, never in plain text.
providers.confirm_disconnect_desc: The token will be removed from the system keychain. You can reconnect any time.
providers.bitbucket_username_hint: Bitbucket app-passwords must be paired with your account username — this is the value shown on your profile page (bitbucket.org/<username>), not your email.
providers.base_url_hint: Override for self-hosted instances (GitHub Enterprise, GitLab self-managed, Bitbucket Server). Leave blank to use the default cloud endpoint.

desktop.web_disabled: These settings only apply when running the desktop app.
desktop.auto_start_desc: Launch Recrest when you log in.
desktop.auto_start_failed: Couldn't update the system autostart entry. Please try again or check the OS autostart settings.
desktop.start_minimized_desc: Open silently to the system tray instead of a foreground window.
desktop.close_to_tray_desc: Keep Recrest running in the tray when you close the window.
desktop.close_to_tray_hint: The system tray is the small icon area next to your clock. With this enabled, pressing the window close button hides Recrest there instead of quitting — click the tray icon to bring it back. Use Quit from the tray menu to actually exit.

notifications.enabled_desc: Allow Recrest to send native notifications.

updates.mode_hint: Automatic: download and install updates in the background, relaunch the app when ready. Notify me: tell me when one is available and let me decide. Off: never check.

updater.manual_note: Local builds can't auto-install — updates open in your browser.

diagnostics.crash_reporting_desc: Send anonymised crash reports to help us fix bugs.
diagnostics.crash_reporting_hint: Only triggered when Recrest crashes. Reports include the error, stack trace, OS/architecture and app version. No repo contents, paths, tokens or git data are sent.
diagnostics.git_hint: Recrest ships its own libgit2, so reading repo status works regardless. A system-wide git is only needed for future fetch/pull actions.

developer.title: Developer
developer.intro: Debug-only tools. These settings are hidden in production builds.

factoryReset.title: Reset to factory defaults
factoryReset.row_sub: Wipes settings, tokens, localStorage, and re-runs onboarding.
factoryReset.description: Wipes every setting, all stored provider tokens, and any cached UI state. The onboarding wizard will appear again on next launch.
factoryReset.confirmBody: This wipes settings, tokens, localStorage, and re-runs onboarding. The page will reload.

updater.force_fallback_sub: Treat the auto-installer path as broken — surface the manual download link instead.
updater.reset_last_seen_sub: Make the update banner appear again for the current version.

storage.copy_state_sub: Snapshot the store as JSON with secrets redacted.
storage.clear_tokens_confirm_title: Clear ALL provider tokens from keychain?
storage.open_onboarding_sub: Show the first-run wizard now — does not touch saved settings.

ipc.toggle_devtools_sub: Opens the webview's built-in inspector (Tauri only).
ipc.trace_calls_sub: Log every invoke + event to the dev console with timing info.

i18n.highlight_missing_sub: Underline strings that fall through to the default value.

notifications.send_burst_sub: Inject 7 fake PRs from a dev-burst repo to test coalescing behavior.
